welcome_lead: You'll meet the 4 Ps, learn about market segmentation, and understand what makes a USP.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies marketing foundations — the 4 Ps, segmentation and unique selling points.
final_note: You can identify the 4 Ps, describe market segmentation, and explain why a USP matters.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Marketing is not just adverts — it's finding and satisfying customers profitably.

It starts with research and runs all the way through to product design, pricing, distribution and promotion.

Few products suit everyone, so firms split the market into segments.

Common bases: demographic (age/income), geographic (region), psychographic (lifestyle/values), behavioural (usage).

A USP is what makes a product stand out — could be a feature, price point, ethical stance, or service quality.

A strong brand image turns one-off buyers into loyal customers.
